card.name: Digits and spaces inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the first part of a dose number in label text. This includes a space before a number such as 20 mg, a decimal point in 0.3 mg, or a leading digit. It also fires on a few word beginnings such as meth in methane.
